status.description: PUBLISHED only after the Host publisher succeeds, including a first Host-valid reversible default for an ambiguous item; NO_CHANGE when source already satisfies the handoff or no grounded change exists; UNRESOLVED only when no Host-valid proposal can be formed. UNRESOLVED keeps the current structure and is non-blocking.

reason_code.description: Use revision_published for PUBLISHED; source_already_satisfies_handoff or no_grounded_change for NO_CHANGE; evidence_insufficient or operation_not_supported for non-blocking UNRESOLVED with current structure retained.
